LF nat : type =
| z : nat
| s : nat -> nat
;

LF bool : type =
| btrue : bool
| bfalse : bool

LF plus : nat -> nat -> nat -> type =
| plus_z : plus z N N
| plus_s : plus (s M) N (s P) <- plus M N P
;

LF mult : nat -> nat -> nat -> type =
| mult_z : mult z N z
| mult_s : mult (s M) N P <- mult M N Q <- plus N Q P
;

LF leq : nat -> nat -> type =
| leq_z : leq z N
| leq_s : leq (s M) (s N) <- leq M N

LF lt : nat -> nat -> type =

LF shape : type =

LF total_elements : shape -> nat -> type =

LF stride_spec : shape -> nat -> nat -> type =
| ss_last : stride_spec (shape_cons D shape_nil) z (s z)
| ss_cons : stride_spec (shape_cons D (shape_cons D2 S)) Pos Stride <- stride_spec (shape_cons D2 S) (s Pos) NextStride <- mult D2 NextStride Stride

rec plus_commutative : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N:[g |- nat]}{P:[g |- nat]} [g |- plus M N P] -> [g |- plus N M P] =
mlam M => mlam N => mlam P => fn d =>
case [_ |- M] of
| [g |- z] => 
  let [g |- plus_z] = d in [g |- plus_z]
| [g |- s M'] => 
  let [g |- plus_s D] = d in
  let [g |- D'] = plus_commutative [g |- M'] [g |- N] [_ |- _] [g |- D] in
  [g |- plus_s D']
;

rec plus_associative : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N:[g |- nat]}{K:[g |- nat]}{P:[g |- nat]}{Q:[g |- nat]}{R:[g |- nat]} [g |- plus M N P] -> [g |- plus P K R] -> [g |- plus N K Q] -> [g |- plus M Q R] =
mlam M => mlam N => mlam K => mlam P => mlam Q => mlam R => fn d1 => fn d2 => fn d3 =>
case [_ |- M] of
| [g |- z] => 
  let [g |- plus_z] = d1 in d2
| [g |- s M'] => 
  let [g |- plus_s D1] = d1 in
  let [g |- plus_s D2] = d2 in
  let [g |- D'] = plus_associative [g |- M'] [_ |- N] [_ |- K] [_ |- _] [_ |- Q] [_ |- _] [g |- D1] [g |- D2] d3 in
  [g |- plus_s D']
;

rec plus_deterministic : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N:[g |- nat]}{P1:[g |- nat]}{P2:[g |- nat]} [g |- plus M N P1] -> [g |- plus M N P2] -> [g |- P1] = [g |- P2] =
mlam M => mlam N => mlam P1 => mlam P2 => fn d1 => fn d2 =>
case d1 of
| [g |- plus_z] => 
  case d2 of
  | [g |- plus_z] => [g |- refl]
| [g |- plus_s D1] => 
  case d2 of
  | [g |- plus_s D2] =>
    let [g |- refl] = plus_deterministic [_ |- _] [_ |- N] [_ |- _] [_ |- _] [g |- D1] [g |- D2] in
    [g |- refl]
;

rec mult_commutative : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N:[g |- nat]}{P:[g |- nat]} [g |- mult M N P] -> [g |- mult N M P] =
mlam M => mlam N => mlam P => fn d =>
case [_ |- M] of
| [g |- z] => 
  let [g |- mult_z] = d in [g |- mult_z]
| [g |- s M'] => 
  let [g |- mult_s D1 D2] = d in
  let [g |- D1'] = mult_commutative [g |- M'] [_ |- N] [_ |- _] [g |- D1] in
  [g |- mult_s D1' D2]
;

rec mult_distributive : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N:[g |- nat]}{K:[g |- nat]}{P:[g |- nat]}{Q:[g |- nat]}{R:[g |- nat]} [g |- mult M N P] -> [g |- mult M K Q] -> [g |- plus N K R] -> [g |- mult M R (plus P Q)] =
mlam M => mlam N => mlam K => mlam P => mlam Q => mlam R => fn d1 => fn d2 => fn d3 =>
case [_ |- M] of
| [g |- z] => 
  let [g |- mult_z] = d1 in 
  let [g |- mult_z] = d2 in 
  [g |- mult_z]
| [g |- s M'] => 
  let [g |- mult_s D1 D2] = d1 in
  let [g |- mult_s D3 D4] = d2 in
  let [g |- D'] = mult_distributive [g |- M'] [_ |- N] [_ |- K] [_ |- _] [_ |- _] [_ |- R] [g |- D1] [g |- D3] d3 in
  [g |- mult_s D' (plus_s D2)]
;

rec mult_deterministic : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N:[g |- nat]}{P1:[g |- nat]}{P2:[g |- nat]} [g |- mult M N P1] -> [g |- mult M N P2] -> [g |- P1] = [g |- P2] =
mlam M => mlam N => mlam P1 => mlam P2 => fn d1 => fn d2 =>
case d1 of
| [g |- mult_z] => 
  case d2 of
  | [g |- mult_z] => [g |- refl]
| [g |- mult_s D1 D2] => 
  case d2 of
  | [g |- mult_s D3 D4] =>
    let [g |- refl] = mult_deterministic [_ |- _] [_ |- N] [_ |- _] [_ |- _] [g |- D1] [g |- D3] in
    [g |- refl]
;

rec leq_reflexive : (g:ctx) {N:[g |- nat]} [g |- leq N N] =
mlam N => 
case [_ |- N] of
| [g |- z] => [g |- leq_z]
| [g |- s N'] => 
  let [g |- D] = leq_reflexive [g |- N'] in 
  [g |- leq_s D]
;

rec leq_transitive : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N:[g |- nat]}{K:[g |- nat]} [g |- leq M N] -> [g |- leq N K] -> [g |- leq M K] =
mlam M => mlam N => mlam K => fn d1 => fn d2 =>
case [_ |- M] of
| [g |- z] => [g |- leq_z]
| [g |- s M'] => 
  case [_ |- N] of
  | [g |- s N'] => 
    case [_ |- K] of
    | [g |- s K'] => 
      let [g |- leq_s D1] = d1 in 
      let [g |- leq_s D2] = d2 in
      let [g |- D] = leq_transitive [g |- M'] [g |- N'] [g |- K'] [g |- D1] [g |- D2] in
      [g |- leq_s D]
;

rec leq_antisymmetric : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N:[g |- nat]} [g |- leq M N] -> [g |- leq N M] -> [g |- M] = [g |- N] =
mlam M => mlam N => fn d1 => fn d2 =>
case [_ |- M] of
| [g |- z] => 
  case [_ |- N] of
  | [g |- z] => [g |- refl]
| [g |- s M'] => 
  case [_ |- N] of
  | [g |- s N'] => 
    let [g |- leq_s D1] = d1 in 
    let [g |- leq_s D2] = d2 in
    let [g |- refl] = leq_antisymmetric [g |- M'] [g |- N'] [g |- D1] [g |- D2] in
    [g |- refl]
;

rec lt_irreflexive : (g:ctx) {N:[g |- nat]} [g |- lt N N] -> [g |- bool] =
mlam N => fn d =>
case d of
| [g |- lt_base] => [g |- bfalse]
| [g |- lt_step D] => lt_irreflexive [_ |- _] [g |- D]
;

rec lt_transitive : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N:[g |- nat]}{K:[g |- nat]} [g |- lt M N] -> [g |- lt N K] -> [g |- lt M K] =
mlam M => mlam N => mlam K => fn d1 => fn d2 =>
case d2 of
| [g |- lt_base] => [g |- lt_step d1]
| [g |- lt_step D] => 
  let [g |- D'] = lt_transitive [_ |- M] [_ |- N] [_ |- _] d1 [g |- D] in
  [g |- lt_step D']
;

rec lt_deterministic_witness : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N1:[g |- nat]}{N2:[g |- nat]} [g |- lt M N1] -> [g |- lt M N2] -> [g |- leq N1 N2] =
mlam M => mlam N1 => mlam N2 => fn d1 => fn d2 =>
case d1 of
| [g |- lt_base] => 
  case d2 of
  | [g |- lt_base] => leq_reflexive [_ |- _]
  | [g |- lt_step D] => [g |- leq_s leq_z]
| [g |- lt_step D1] => 
  case d2 of
  | [g |- lt_base] => [g |- leq_z]
  | [g |- lt_step D2] => 
    let [g |- D] = lt_deterministic_witness [_ |- M] [_ |- _] [_ |- _] [g |- D1] [g |- D2] in
    [g |- leq_s D]
;

module CelestialZO

using LinearAlgebra
using Random
using Statistics
using Printf
using Dates
using FFTW

struct CelestialZO
    dim::Int
    epsilon::Float64
    n_samples::Int
    lr::Float64
    target_radius::Float64
    harmony_feedback::Float64
    metrics::Dict{String, Float64}
    rng::MersenneTwister
end

function CelestialZO(dim::Int; epsilon::Float64=1e-5, n_samples::Int=100, lr::Float64=1e-3, target_radius::Float64=1.15, harmony_feedback::Float64=0.75)
    rng = MersenneTwister(4625809 + 2014014)
    metrics = Dict("loss" => 0.0, "spectral_radius" => 0.0)
    CelestialZO(dim, epsilon, n_samples, lr, target_radius, harmony_feedback, metrics, rng)
end

function perturb(opt::CelestialZO, x::Vector{Float64})::Tuple{Vector{Vector{Float64}}, Vector{Vector{Float64}}}
    perturbations = [opt.epsilon .* randn(opt.rng, opt.dim) for _ in 1:opt.n_samples]
    perturbed = [x .+ p for p in perturbations]
    (perturbed, perturbations)
end

function estimate_gradient(opt::CelestialZO, func::Function, x::Vector{Float64}, perturbed::Vector{Vector{Float64}}, perturbations::Vector{Vector{Float64}})::Vector{Float64}
    f_pert = [func(p) for p in perturbed]
    mean_f = mean(f_pert)
    grad = zeros(Float64, opt.dim)
    for i in 1:opt.n_samples
        grad .+= (f_pert[i] - mean_f) .* perturbations[i] ./ (opt.n_samples * opt.epsilon^2)
    end
    grad
end

function apply_harmony_feedback(opt::CelestialZO, grad::Vector{Float64})::Vector{Float64}
    feedback = opt.harmony_feedback .* sin.(norm(grad) .* (2 * pi / opt.target_radius))
    grad .+= feedback .* grad
    grad
end

function spectral_normalize!(opt::CelestialZO, x::Vector{Float64}, grad::Vector{Float64})
    sqrt_dim = isqrt(opt.dim)
    if sqrt_dim * sqrt_dim != opt.dim
        error("Dimension must be a perfect square for SVD reshaping")
    end
    A = reshape(x, sqrt_dim, sqrt_dim)
    F = svd(A)
    U, S, V = F.U, F.S, F.Vt'
    current_radius = maximum(S)
    opt.metrics["spectral_radius"] = current_radius
    if current_radius > opt.target_radius
        scale = opt.target_radius / current_radius
        x[:] = vec(U * Diagonal(S .* scale) * V)
    end
end

function step!(opt::CelestialZO, func::Function, x::Vector{Float64})::Vector{Float64}
    perturbed, perturbations = perturb(opt, x)
    grad = estimate_gradient(opt, func, x, perturbed, perturbations)
    grad = apply_harmony_feedback(opt, grad)
    x .-= opt.lr .* grad
    spectral_normalize!(opt, x, grad)
    opt.metrics["loss"] = func(x)
    x
end

function optimize!(opt::CelestialZO, func::Function, x0::Vector{Float64}; max_iter::Int=1000, tol::Float64=1e-6)
    x = copy(x0)
    prev_loss = func(x)
    for i in 1:max_iter
        x = step!(opt, func, x)
        loss = opt.metrics["loss"]
        if abs(loss - prev_loss) < tol
            break
        end
        prev_loss = loss
    end
    x
end

function benchmark_optimizer(opt::CelestialZO, func, x0::Vector{Float64}, iters::Int)
    start_time = time()
    x = copy(x0)
    losses = Float64[]
    for i in 1:iters
        x = step!(opt, func, x)
        push!(losses, opt.metrics["loss"])
    end
    elapsed = time() - start_time
    println("Benchmark: $(iters) steps in $(elapsed)s, Avg Loss: $(mean(losses))")
    (time=elapsed, losses=losses)
end

function quadratic_loss(x::Vector{Float64})
    0.5 * dot(x, x)
end

function lorenz_perturbation(dim::Int, steps::Int=100)
    sigma, rho, beta = 10.0, 28.0, 8/3
    x, y, z = 0.1, 0.0, 0.0
    dt = 0.01
    traj = zeros(Float64, dim, 3)
    current_step = 1
    for t in 1:dim
        dx = sigma * (y - x) * dt
        dy = (x * (rho - z) - y) * dt
        dz = (x * y - beta * z) * dt
        x += dx; y += dy; z += dz
        traj[t, 1] = x
        if t >= dim
            break
        end
    end
    traj[:, 1]
end

function celestial_objective(x::Vector{Float64}, traj::Vector{Float64})
    base_loss = quadratic_loss(x)
    pert_len = min(length(traj), length(x))
    pert = traj[1:pert_len]
    if length(pert) < length(x)
        pert = vcat(pert, zeros(Float64, length(x) - length(pert)))
    end
    perturbed_x = x + 0.01 * pert
    0.5 * base_loss + 0.1 * norm(perturbed_x - x)
end

function main()
    dim = 512
    opt = CelestialZO(dim)
    x0 = randn(Float64, dim)
    traj = lorenz_perturbation(dim)
    obj = x -> celestial_objective(x, traj)
    final_x = optimize!(opt, obj, x0)
    println("Optimized params norm: ", norm(final_x))
    bench = benchmark_optimizer(opt, obj, x0, 1000)
    println("Benchmark results: ", bench)
end

main()

    let global_grads = all_reduce_gradients(workers, global_state.config)

    total_loss += list.sum(list.map(workers, fn(w) { w.loss })) / global_state.config.num_workers.to_float()
  }
  let avg_loss = total_loss / 100.0
  let convergence = check_convergence(workers)
  GlobalState(
    global_state.config,
    workers,
    global_grads,
    global_state.epoch + 1,
    avg_loss,
    convergence,
  )
}

pub fn main_distributed_train(
  config: DistributedTrainingConfig,
  model: Dynamic,
  epochs: Int,
) -> GlobalState {
  let manager = new_checkpoint_manager("./distributed_checkpoints")
  let dataloader = create_dataloader(config)
  var global = GlobalState(config, init_workers(config, model), dynamic.from(@{}), 0, 0.0, False)
  for e in 0..epochs {

  let all_metrics = list.concat_map(workers, fn(w) { list.to_tuple_list(w.metrics) })

    let key = tuple.first(kv)
    let val = dynamic.as_float(tuple.second(kv)).unwrap_or(0.0)
    map.insert(acc, key, val)
  })

rec plus_commutative : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N:[g |- nat]}{P:[g |- nat]} [g |- plus M N P] -> [g |- plus N M P] =
mlam M => mlam N => mlam P => fn d =>
case [_ |- M] of
| [g |- z] => 
  let [g |- plus_z] = d in [g |- plus_z]
| [g |- s M'] => 
  let [g |- plus_s D] = d in
  let [g |- D'] = plus_commutative [g |- M'] [g |- N] [_ |- _] [g |- D] in
  [g |- plus_s D']
;

mlam M => mlam N => mlam K => mlam P => mlam Q => mlam R => fn d1 => fn d2 => fn d3 =>
case [_ |- M] of
| [g |- z] => 
  let [g |- plus_z] = d1 in d2
| [g |- s M'] => 
  let [g |- plus_s D1] = d1 in
  let [g |- plus_s D2] = d2 in
  let [g |- D'] = plus_associative [g |- M'] [_ |- N] [_ |- K] [_ |- _] [_ |- Q] [_ |- _] [g |- D1] [g |- D2] d3 in
  [g |- plus_s D']

| [g |- plus_z] =>

  | [g |- plus_z] => [g |- refl]
| [g |- plus_s D1] =>

rec mult_commutative : (g:ctx) {M:[g |- nat]}{N:[g |- nat]}{P:[g |- nat]} [g |- mult M N P] -> [g |- mult N M P] =

  let [g |- D1'] = mult_commutative [g |- M'] [_ |- N] [_ |- _] [g |- D1] in

| [g |- s M'] =>

mlam M => mlam N => mlam K => fn d1 => fn d2 =>

| [g |- z] => [g |- leq_z]
| [g |- s M'] => 
  case [_ |- N] of
  | [g |- s N'] => 
    case [_ |- K] of
    | [g |- s K'] => 
      let [g |- leq_s D1] = d1 in 
      let [g |- leq_s D2] = d2 in
      let [g |- D] = leq_transitive [g |- M'] [g |- N'] [g |- K'] [g |- D1] [g |- D2] in

mlam M => mlam N => fn d1 => fn d2 =>
case [_ |- M] of
| [g |- z] => 
  case [_ |- N] of
  | [g |- z] => [g |- refl]
| [g |- s M'] => 
  case [_ |- N] of
  | [g |- s N'] =>

module CelestialZO

using LinearAlgebra
using Random
using Statistics
using Printf
using Dates
using FFTW

struct CelestialZO
    dim::Int
    epsilon::Float64
    n_samples::Int
    lr::Float64
    target_radius::Float64
    harmony_feedback::Float64
    metrics::Dict{String, Float64}
    rng::MersenneTwister
end

function CelestialZO(dim::Int; epsilon::Float64=1e-5, n_samples::Int=100, lr::Float64=1e-3, target_radius::Float64=1.15, harmony_feedback::Float64=0.75)
    rng = MersenneTwister(4625809 + 2014014)
    metrics = Dict("loss" => 0.0, "spectral_radius" => 0.0)
    CelestialZO(dim, epsilon, n_samples, lr, target_radius, harmony_feedback, metrics, rng)
end

function perturb(opt::CelestialZO, x::Vector{Float64})::Tuple{Vector{Vector{Float64}}, Vector{Vector{Float64}}}
    perturbations = [opt.epsilon .* randn(opt.rng, opt.dim) for _ in 1:opt.n_samples]
    perturbed = [x .+ p for p in perturbations]
    (perturbed, perturbations)
end

function estimate_gradient(opt::CelestialZO, func::Function, x::Vector{Float64}, perturbed::Vector{Vector{Float64}}, perturbations::Vector{Vector{Float64}})::Vector{Float64}
    f_pert = [func(p) for p in perturbed]
    mean_f = mean(f_pert)
    grad = zeros(Float64, opt.dim)
    for i in 1:opt.n_samples
        grad .+= (f_pert[i] - mean_f) .* perturbations[i] ./ (opt.n_samples * opt.epsilon^2)
    end
    grad
end

function apply_harmony_feedback(opt::CelestialZO, grad::Vector{Float64})::Vector{Float64}
    feedback = opt.harmony_feedback .* sin.(norm(grad) .* (2 * pi / opt.target_radius))
    grad .+= feedback .* grad
    grad
end

function spectral_normalize!(opt::CelestialZO, x::Vector{Float64}, grad::Vector{Float64})
    sqrt_dim = isqrt(opt.dim)
    if sqrt_dim * sqrt_dim != opt.dim
        error("Dimension must be a perfect square for SVD reshaping")
    end
    A = reshape(x, sqrt_dim, sqrt_dim)
    F = svd(A)
    U, S, V = F.U, F.S, F.Vt'
    current_radius = maximum(S)
    opt.metrics["spectral_radius"] = current_radius
    if current_radius > opt.target_radius
        scale = opt.target_radius / current_radius
        x[:] = vec(U * Diagonal(S .* scale) * V)
    end
end

function step!(opt::CelestialZO, func::Function, x::Vector{Float64})::Vector{Float64}
    perturbed, perturbations = perturb(opt, x)
    grad = estimate_gradient(opt, func, x, perturbed, perturbations)
    grad = apply_harmony_feedback(opt, grad)
    x .-= opt.lr .* grad
    spectral_normalize!(opt, x, grad)
    opt.metrics["loss"] = func(x)
    x
end

function optimize!(opt::CelestialZO, func::Function, x0::Vector{Float64}; max_iter::Int=1000, tol::Float64=1e-6)
    x = copy(x0)
    prev_loss = func(x)
    for i in 1:max_iter
        x = step!(opt, func, x)
        loss = opt.metrics["loss"]
        if abs(loss - prev_loss) < tol
            break
        end
        prev_loss = loss
    end
    x
end

function benchmark_optimizer(opt::CelestialZO, func, x0::Vector{Float64}, iters::Int)
    start_time = time()
    x = copy(x0)
    losses = Float64[]
    for i in 1:iters
        x = step!(opt, func, x)
        push!(losses, opt.metrics["loss"])
    end
    elapsed = time() - start_time
    println("Benchmark: $(iters) steps in $(elapsed)s, Avg Loss: $(mean(losses))")
    (time=elapsed, losses=losses)
end

function quadratic_loss(x::Vector{Float64})
    0.5 * dot(x, x)
end

function lorenz_perturbation(dim::Int, steps::Int=100)
    sigma, rho, beta = 10.0, 28.0, 8/3
    x, y, z = 0.1, 0.0, 0.0
    dt = 0.01
    traj = zeros(Float64, dim, 3)
    current_step = 1
    for t in 1:dim
        dx = sigma * (y - x) * dt
        dy = (x * (rho - z) - y) * dt
        dz = (x * y - beta * z) * dt
        x += dx; y += dy; z += dz
        traj[t, 1] = x
        if t >= dim
            break
        end
    end
    traj[:, 1]
end

function celestial_objective(x::Vector{Float64}, traj::Vector{Float64})
    base_loss = quadratic_loss(x)
    pert_len = min(length(traj), length(x))
    pert = traj[1:pert_len]
    if length(pert) < length(x)
        pert = vcat(pert, zeros(Float64, length(x) - length(pert)))
    end
    perturbed_x = x + 0.01 * pert
    0.5 * base_loss + 0.1 * norm(perturbed_x - x)
end
